I listened to this playlist while writing my own novel, "Nummer Neun."

Somehow, these songs helped me reach emotions I couldn’t always put into words. They allowed me to connect more deeply with myself and pour those feelings into the story — the hope, the loneliness, the love, the fear, and everything in between.

This playlist didn’t just make Nummer Neun a better story. In a way, writing with these songs made me more honest with myself, too. It helped me understand what I was feeling, gave those emotions a place to exist, and turned them into something meaningful.

So this isn’t just the soundtrack to a story I wrote.

It’s a small part of the story behind it. ❤

That's an incredibly powerful and moving comment. It's amazing to hear how the music resonated with you and helped you connect with your emotions to enrich your novel, "Nummer Neun." We're so glad the playlist could be a part of your creative journey and personal growth.
